task.title: [M6] Operator frame selection, PTS provenance and timing separation
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M6
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M6-02
**Implementation status:** Backlog (to-do); planned only, no implementation or verification claimed. Kaneo column is authoritative if later changed.
**Responsible implementer:** Unassigned. Required skill: Authorized engineer for this bounded deliverable; independent reviewer is separate.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§2.1–2.3, 5.3, 6/M6
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Let the operator choose actual video frames for existing finite requirements.

**Scope:** Video timeline/keyframe candidate selection, explicit mapping, crop/alpha placement and source provenance UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Operator selects display-order frames and maps to declared action/view/frame/layer IDs; retain source hash, source PTS, selected frame hash and selection revision.
- [ ] Show source PTS independently from ACT/runtime playback timing, including VFR and candidate gaps.
- [ ] Manual placement/crop/alpha choices use versioned M4 recipes and before/after previews with affected approval invalidation.
- [ ] No missing poses/views are inferred, auto-filled or aesthetically accepted; selection and review remain operator actions.

## Verification

Selection/reopen provenance tests, VFR timeline and runtime-timing separation checks; operator review flow.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. No tests, approvals or native runs are claimed by this planning record.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-28 (M6-01; task ID mdehayoorrfc43z930ij72wx); RSF-18 (M3-04; task ID reuc1z3obcspcrn7xb55dzvk)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Only the stated deliverable; no adjacent milestone implementation or automatic artistic/native acceptance.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code changes / diff: Not implemented by this planning sync.
- Test commands / exit statuses / artifact hashes: NOT_RUN (planning only).
- Milestone gates / limitations: Not evaluated; structural, coverage, visual, preview and native states remain separate.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

Not performed for implementation. Implementer supplies evidence and moves to QA Review; a distinct read-only reviewer records QA_PASS / QA_FAIL / QA_BLOCKED. Operator-only visual/native decisions remain separate. No acceptance is granted by backlog creation.

additional_dependency.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M3
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M3-04
**Implementation status:** Implemented; independent QA_PASS. Acceptance supported by the execution evidence below.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex (aM3as9DCoQ7pMoO3V9XsDbL3q2j9pWjn). Independent read-only reviewer: forge_qa_reviewer /root/rsf18_independent_qa.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§2.3, 4.3–4.6, 5.2/E, 6/M3, 14
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Bind human review to exactly the composition visible before compilation.

**Scope:** Canonical visual composition digest, operator approve/reject/batch scope, dependency tracking and stale-review workflow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Canonical pre-build revision covers source-content hashes, assignments, ordered layers, recipes/crops/transforms, timing/offsets/anchors, target/profile and preview semantics.
- [x] Only operator can approve/reject a displayed frame/view/action/batch with precise scope and digest; approval exists before output build hashes.
- [x] Changes affecting visual inputs invalidate only affected scope; equivalent inputs/unrelated rebuilds do not invalidate approval; save/reopen preserves valid review.
- [x] PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED preview yields explicitly provisional inspection, never faithful-runtime approval; native acceptance remains separate.
- [x] Unchanged structural-only imports may record NOT_REQUIRED under explicit policy; replacement artwork requires applicable review. Missing/stale approval prevents production readiness.

## Verification

Canonical digest equivalence and affected-only invalidation tests; operator batch/rejection/reopen flow; future build hash independence check.

Actual execution evidence follows. Original planning scope is preserved; all automated review decisions used isolated synthetic art, never private artwork.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-17 (M3-03; task ID j4bq4r7uxi9z6l378go7oomo)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No auto-approval or aesthetic scoring.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

- core/review.py: canonical pre-build basis extends existing ledger dependency/composition identity with exact ordered-frame context, target/profile, timing/anchor constraints and renderer/preview semantics. Closed packaged review-event/v1 schema; optional project history preserves compatibility.
- Service proposal reconstructs persisted current inputs; atomic exact-scope decisions and optimistic revisions reject stale/batch conflicts. History persists; generic saves cannot inject approvals. Ephemeral coverage projection preserves assignment revisions.
- Workbench presents exact scope, actual source-layer previews, lineage and basis/evidence hashes before explicit Approve/Reject. Layer/frame/view/action/explicit batch selections are supported.
- Provisional ordered source-layer review only, clearly PARTIAL; not compiled-animation/native/artistic acceptance. Unexecuted transforms cannot be approved or exempted. NOT_REQUIRED requires explicit unchanged-reference structural-only policy. export_ready=false.
- Python3.14.4: focused19 PASS, public318 PASS, private36 PASS, all exit0. Six schema checkers PASS; node syntax PASS. Final offline installed distribution318 collected, OK(skipped2 optional-dependency tests), repeated wheel hash/isolation/private-asset exclusions PASS. Python3.12/3.13 NOT_RUN unavailable.
- Actual Playwright MCP Chromium156.0.8078.73: coordinator and independent reviewer directly ran fresh synthetic journeys. ## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

QA_PASS — configured forge_qa_reviewer /root/rsf18_independent_qa independently inspected live five criteria and ran current-source318 public,36 private,19 focused and six schema checks, all exit0. Reviewer directly executed Playwright MCP in fresh synthetic project rsf18-1793352647508; all seven journeys passed, no unexpected console/network failures. This improves RSF17 browser independence.
